project.title: Project
project.none_open: No project is open. Create one, open one, or pick an area of interest in the first step to start one automatically.
project.name_chars: Use letters, digits, spaces, '-' and '_' only.
project.name_exists: A project with this name already exists.
project.set_load_failed: Could not load the alerts of the active set: {error}
project.delete_message: This deletes the project folder and every file in it. Type the project name to confirm.
project.delete_busy: A task is still writing into this project. Wait for it to finish, then delete.
project.duplicate_hint: The copy keeps the AOI, sources and grid, without periods or alert sets.

aoi.title: Area of interest
aoi.description: Pick the area to monitor. It is saved with the project and every download is cut to it.
aoi.locked: This project already has alert sets, so its AOI is locked. Duplicate the project (Project dialog) to monitor another area.
aoi.no_geometry: The AOI has no usable geometry; select it again in the AOI step.

alerts.title: Alert sources
alerts.description: The alert datasets this project monitors. Each is downloaded separately for every period, cut to the AOI and the period's dates.
alerts.empty: No alert source yet. Add at least one.
alerts.all_added: Every predefined source is already in this project.
alerts.meta_loading: Still reading the catalogue dates; try again in a moment.
alerts.meta_failed: Could not load the catalogue dates: {error}
alerts.delete_message: The source is removed from the project. Its downloaded files stay until they are replaced.
alerts.delete_used: {n} alert set(s) used this source. They keep their alerts; new sets won't include it.

period.title: Period
period.description: The monitoring period. Alerts dated inside it (plus the look-back days before it, to catch late-published alerts) are downloaded for every source.
period.look_back_hint: Days before the start that are searched too. Pixels already reported by an earlier period are skipped.
period.locked: This period already has an alert set, so its dates are fixed. More periods per project arrive in a later version.
period.error_order: The end date must be after the start date.
period.error_bad_look_back: Look-back must be a whole number of days, 0 or more.
period.error_locked: This period already has an alert set; its dates can't change.

prepare.title: Download & harmonize
prepare.description: Each source is downloaded for the period's search window in its own projection, then aligned onto the project grid (harmonized). Nothing whose inputs are unchanged is downloaded twice; a grid change only re-harmonizes.
prepare.grid_size: {w} × {h} pixels, about {gb} GB per source before compression
prepare.grid_large: This grid is large: downloads will take a while and use disk space.
prepare.grid_locked: The grid is locked because the project has alert sets.
prepare.grid_geographic: Use a projected CRS in metres (the ⌖ button picks the UTM zone of the AOI).
prepare.grid_bad_resolution: Enter a resolution in metres, greater than 0.

integrate.title: Integrate & vectorize
integrate.description: Combine the downloaded sources, skip pixels an earlier period already reported, and turn the clusters into alerts.
integrate.min_size_hint: Clusters smaller than this ({px} pixels on the grid) are dropped.
integrate.area_drawn: Drawn polygon (draw it on the map)
integrate.attr_no_source: Pick an image or a GeoTIFF first.
integrate.will_create: Creates or replaces the alert set {period} · {sources}
integrate.replace_message: {n} reviewed alert(s) in this set will be discarded.
integrate.no_tippecanoe: tippecanoe is not installed: Overview will show alert points without polygons.
integrate.tiles_failed: The map tiles could not be built ({error}); Overview builds them again when it opens.
integrate.done_empty: No new alerts in this period: the alert set is empty.
integrate.project_changed: The project's period, area of interest or grid changed while the run was going, so the alert set was not recorded. Run Integrate & vectorize again.
integrate.error_min_size: Enter a minimum size in hectares, 0 or more.
integrate.error_max_alerts: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
integrate.error_no_drawing: Draw at least one polygon on the map first.

overview.stale: This set was built from inputs that have changed since. Re-run Integrate & vectorize to rebuild it (that discards its reviews).
overview.tiles_failed: The map tiles could not be shown ({error}): showing alert points without polygons.
